Should We Launch It?

A café is deciding whether to launch a new drink. Your job is to read customer feedback and decide which comments count as genuine support.

Read 6 commentsEach day shows six random customer statements drawn from a larger random pool.
Tick supportSelect comments that genuinely support launching the drink.
Update beliefsYour choices update a beta distribution for support.

The app starts with a flat prior, Beta(1,1). If you tick x comments in a day, the posterior becomes Beta(alpha + x, beta + 6 - x).
